{{Quote|Don't lie to me, Dofine. First it was twenty thousand, then fifty, now one hundred. How much will we have to forfeit the next time the Trade Federation graces Dorvalla with a visit?|Unidentified female Human to Daultay Dofine|<ref name="cod" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for [[Dorvalla Mining]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]].<ref name="cod" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> the [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] ''[[Revenue]]'', a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], was at Dorvalla loading a cargo of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] ore. The human complained to [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] aboard the ''Revenue'', that their payment was short by one hundred thousand Republic [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Dofine initially denied the accusation, but the human reminded him that their previous encounters had also netted in incomplete payments. Dofine then mocked her by suggesting that she file a complaint to the [[Trade Commission]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="cod" />
